newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO Chicago names Ricchiuto chief economist.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO Chicago names Ricchiuto chief economist.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp announced on Friday it named Steven Ricchiuto as chief economist, effective immediately.
Carl Tannenbaum will continue as chief economist at ABN AMRO Bank, North America, said an ABN AMRO spokeswoman.
She said Ricchiuto's position was a new one, created after ABN AMRO Securities (USA) Inc merged with Chicago Corp late last year.
Ricchiuto was chief economist at Dean Witter Reynolds Inc from November until May, but did not work for the newly combined entity of Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co.
Prior to that he had been chief economist at Barclays de Zoette Wedd (BZW) Securities Inc for eight years.
Ricchiuto's duties will include formulating and marketing the firm's macroeconomic and interest rate forecasts.
ABN AMRO Chicago Corp is a subsidiary of ABN AMRO Bank N.V. of the Netherlands, the world's 14th largest bank with $385 billion of assets worldwide, $72 billion in North America.
